resources.string: Lock the computer, control what is playing and turn focus on, with one tap.

Lets you use this phone from its window on your own computer, while Adaptive Link is showing the phone\'s screen there: what you click and type in that window is done here. It does nothing at any other time, and reads nothing from the screen.
The computer at a glance: whether it can be reached, its battery and volume.
What the computer is playing, with previous, play and next.
Your own buttons from the Controls screen.
